name: io.github.Perseus-Computing-LLC/ledger
title: Perseus Ledger — verifiable, hash-chained event provenance
description: Verifiable, hash-chained event provenance for autonomous systems. Local-first, MIT. 5 MCP tools.

tools.name: ledger_health
tools.description: Report the Ledger org, balance, workspace month-to-date spend, and provider health. Read-only.

tools.name: ledger_record
tools.description: Meter one AI call: record provider/model/tokens/cost plus optional task, workspace, external ref, and action provenance into the hash-chained evidence ledger. Scoped write. Action-provenance fields (agent_id, authority_manifest_ref, scope_anchor, action_intent_hash, action_status, approval_ref) are all-or-nothing: supply all of them or none.

provider.description: Provider name (required), e.g. anthropic, openai, bedrock.

cost_usd.description: Exact cost in USD if known; estimated from pricing otherwise.

evidence_hashes.description: Hash-only evidence references (sha256 hex); hash-covered into the event.

result_hash.description: Hash of the action result — never the result itself.

context_render_schema.description: Required with any context-render evidence: context_render_hash, served_memory_provenance_hash, action_receipt_hash.

served_memory_provenance_hash.description: Served-claim digest from a memory recall.

agent_id.description: Agent identity; required with the action-provenance set.

belief_context.description: Decision-time belief-context evidence block (believed/assumed/ignored) — hash-only claims, HMAC-covered in the receipt (#237).

governance_cost.description: Governance self-cost block (wall_ms/cpu_ms/mem_bytes/storage_bytes/tokens/model_calls/approval_waits_ms); internal telemetry excluded from customer-facing totals (#239).

behavior_snapshot.description: Behavior-snapshot receipt pin carrying the sha256 of a canonical agent-run snapshot (#238).

authority_manifest_custody.description: Custody disclosure label for the referenced authority manifest (1f916 taxonomy); unknown custody renders as labeled uncertainty (#241).

tools.name: ledger_query
tools.description: List recent usage events for the org, newest first. Pass `before` (the `_rowid` of the last event from the previous page) to paginate. Read-only.

before.description: Cursor: rowid of the last event seen, for pagination.

tools.name: ledger_verify
tools.description: Walk the usage_events tamper-evidence hash chain and report divergences per org. Read-only.

org.description: Org id or slug; all orgs if omitted.

tools.name: ledger_receipt
tools.description: Build a hash-only served-claim evidence receipt binding a source reference to a ledger event, with optional authority/provenance/scope/state context. Contains no prompts, memory bodies, or secrets. Read-only.

source_ref.description: Reference to the source being served (e.g. vault entity id).

event_ref.description: Ledger event hash or external reference.
